home.creation_description: QuaeroQuesto makes it easy to create powerful, customized questionnaires. With an intuitive interface, flexible templates, and a wide range of question types, you can design complex surveys in just a few clicks while keeping full control over the flow and logic between questions. Multilingual and user-friendly, the tool adapts to your needs—from simple polls to advanced forms.
home.diffusion_description: With QuaeroQuesto, distributing your questionnaires is simple, smart, and fully optimized. Import your contacts (via CSV, API, or CRM integration), manage your mailing lists effortlessly, and send your surveys instantly or at the perfect time. Powered by AI, the platform optimizes send times, automatically segments your audience, and personalizes each message to boost response rates and engagement. Monitor participation in real time and manage your campaigns with complete confidence.
home.exploitation_description: With QuaeroQuesto, turn your results into actionable insights. Visualize your data in real time through interactive tables, charts, and heat maps, and refine your analysis with dynamic filters and variable cross-analysis. Easily export your results to Excel, CSV, Power BI, or any external analytics tool. Powered by AI, QuaeroQuesto goes further — it automatically analyzes responses, detects trends and correlations, categorizes open answers by theme or sentiment, and suggests strategic actions to help you make the most of your data.
home.generation_rapport_description: With QuaeroQuesto, create professional, impactful reports perfectly aligned with your visual identity. Choose from customizable templates featuring tables, charts, and infographics, then export your reports in PDF, DOCX, or HTML, or share them via an interactive dashboard.Powered by AI, QuaeroQuesto automatically drafts executive summaries, generates multilingual syntheses, and selects the most relevant visualizations for each dataset. Deliver ready-to-share, insight-rich reports enhanced with strategic recommendations.
home.partage_rapport_description: With QuaeroQuesto, share your insights easily and securely. Publish your reports on a dedicated space, manage access rights with precision, and automatically notify stakeholders of updates. Create dynamic dashboards to provide clear, interactive data views. Powered by AI, QuaeroQuesto tailors key insights to each audience — executives, marketing, HR, and more — and automatically generates concise summaries in multiple formats: text, slides, or visual story. Smarter, safer, and more impactful sharing.
